opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text:
The Company had total operating expenses of $20,940 and $0 during the three months ended July 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively. These operating expenses primarily consisted of amortization expense ($5,138) and general and administrative expenses ($15,802), including software development expenses, professional fees and server lease.

The increase in operating expenses was primarily attributable to the fact that the Company was not incorporated during the comparable prior-year period and, accordingly, did not incur operating expenses.
